name: cru_absorb1
desc: The small black cat is sinking into the crocodile's gooey paint chest: its body and legs are already swallowed into the thick pink goo, only its head with the witch hat and its two spread arms still stick out, goo oozing over it, the cat looking dazed and covered in paint. Keep the crocodile's muscular cross pose, toothy sneer and melted puddle base exactly the same.
